turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Here is one example, step by step.
I eat breakfast at seven. My friend Sara eats breakfast at seven.
First I ask: is Sara he, she or it? She is "she".
So I add -s to the verb: eats.
Rule: after he, she or it, the verb takes -s or -es.
Right: He sleeps after lunch. Wrong: He sleep after lunch.

Your turn. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
